provenance: Original fictional teaching cases; no observed market prices, transaction records or empirical probabilities.
units: Values and cash in kCU; share counts in thousands; price in CU per share; rates as fractions of one.
timing: T0 is immediately before simultaneous closing uses; annual rows occur at T1, T2, T3. No incremental cash or residual value after T3.
pricing_contract: Supplied compatible standalone values and 10% incremental cash discount rate. Market-value principal raised or retired at fair value. Old remaining claims unchanged. No incremental financing side effects or additional capital/interest tax shield. Both excess cash balances fully accessible at closing.

eps_case.contract: Start-of-year closing; one full year of supplied common earnings. No financing, fee or acquisition-accounting earnings adjustments; zero net incremental value.

signing_case.contract: Separate owner planning criterion, not an identified market price: physical probability weights and 5% discount. Conditional gains and failure costs occur one year after signing. Failure costs go to outsiders, not the other party.
